title: Henry Ford and the moving assembly line
summary: Born on a farm in what is now Dearborn, Michigan, on 30 July 1863, Henry Ford founded Ford Motor Company on 16 June 1903 and introduced the Model T in 1908. The company brought in a moving assembly line in 1913, and in January 1914 he nearly doubled wages with the Five Dollar Day. Ford died on 7 April 1947.

uncertainty.note: Birth date given by both sources; death date from the Detroit Historical Society.
